summary: Emotional needs flow with imagination and longing. This fluid pattern asks you to use emotional intelligence and compassion with awareness.
body: Emotional needs flow with imagination and longing. This fluid pattern asks you to use emotional intelligence and compassion with awareness. Imaginative and receptive; help seems to arrive from others. The pattern can flow easily, which is useful when it is conscious and easy to take for granted when it is not. In practice, this can show up through emotional needs, imagination and longing, and the choices you make when mood-driven reaction or confusion starts running the room.
gift: The gift is emotional intelligence, compassion, and a more conscious way to work with emotional needs and imagination and longing.
shadow: The shadow is mood-driven reaction, confusion, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let emotional needs and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy.
do: Name how emotional needs and imagination and longing are both involved
Turn emotional intelligence and compassion into one concrete choice
dont: Let mood-driven reaction make the decision
Ignore the needs of emotional needs or imagination and longing
